<title level="1" right="Condition">[Fascinated](/Conditions.aspx?ID=72)</title>

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 443

You're compelled to focus your attention on something, distracting you from whatever else is going on around you. You take a –2 status penalty to Perception and skill checks, and you can't use [concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32) actions unless they (or their intended consequences) are related to the subject of your fascination, as determined by the GM. For instance, you might be able to [Seek](/Actions.aspx?ID=84) and [Recall Knowledge](/Actions.aspx?ID=26) about the subject, but you likely couldn't cast a spell targeting a different creature. This condition ends if a creature uses [hostile actions](/Rules.aspx?ID=300) against you or any of your allies.
name: Fascinated
